mutations.why: The #57 defect itself: with the flag gone gh silently falls back to 30 and the audit renders a truncated list as the complete worklist. Nothing in the suite could see the absent argument before this sprint.

mutations.why: The bound is only honest because something checks whether it was hit. Hard-coding the detector to false restores exactly the silence the fix removes, while leaving every other assertion green - so this is the mutation that proves the cap check, not the limit, is doing the work.

mutations.why: Detecting the cap and never telling the human is the same failure one layer up: the report line would read 'none' for a backlog nobody finished reading. Targets the renderer rather than the detector, so it isolates the half CAPBLIND does not cover.
